tool.name: MeshoptSimplifier
tool.method: simplifyWithAttributes; UV .5 each; six source extrema locked; Permissive; target near3800/far900 triangles; compact original retained vertices; no remeshing or filled holes
tool.geometryFixedFrom: initial-permissive; original near3796/3800 and far899 geometry frozen, no further geometry parameter tuning
tool.uvReplacement: MeshBVH0.9.15 original surface nearest point / barycentric original UV to independent per-LOD-face atlas

changes: Uniform source max(X/Z)width normalization to 1; original +Y retained; source minY translated to zero
Original POS/UV at retained source vertices, UV-aware index simplification; original GLBs have no NORMAL attribute, derived normals computed from actual derivative topology
Only original embedded baseColor image retained; Lanczos downsample to 1024; no wet-scene normal/roughness reinterpretation
Compact Float32 POS/computedNORMAL/UV plus Uint16 indices in binary and synchronous base64 module
Fixed first-pass POS/computedNORMAL triangles retained exactly; face vertices duplicated only to assign independent atlas UV
Original 8k real baseColor rebaked directly, not source-normal/PBR/color synthesis
limits: Source has no supplied survey scale/calibration: unit dimensions do not claim real metres
Original coral plus irregular basal/background patch retained; not a clean narrow-root colony and not terrain collision or a biological tissue model
Seams can simplify in Permissive mode; very fine branches and corallites may be lost
Photographic albedo can contain source underwater lighting; no measured reflectance or color correction claimed
Only derivative asset preview/data checks; no full scene, browser/WebGL or FPS acceptance
Nearest-surface albedo reprojection may choose adjacent surfaces where the fixed simplified mesh bridges fine branches or gaps; low per-face texel resolution loses detail
Independent atlas chart gutters reduce bilinear bleed; no measured physical reflectance or texture visual acceptance implied by budgets
